info.name: Paxos Account Members Payout Groups API

params.name: asset_type
params.description: When set, only payout groups for this asset type (e.g. "USDG", "PYUSD") are returned.

params.name: name_prefix
params.description: When set, only payout groups whose name starts with this prefix are returned (case-insensitive).

params.name: claimer_address
params.description: When set, only payout groups with this claimer address are returned.

params.name: ledger
params.description: When set, only payout groups for this ledger (network) are returned.

params.name: jurisdiction
params.description: When set, only payout groups for this jurisdiction are returned.

params.name: onchain_statuses
params.description: When set, only payout groups with one of these onchain statuses are returned.

params.name: min_balance
params.description: When set, only payout groups with a balance >= this value are returned (in business units, e.g. "1000.50").

items.docs: Retrieves a list of payout groups.

Adds a payout group. A payout group encapsulates common rewards characteristics.
All monitored addresses which reference this payout group will accumulate rewards
at the same rate and claim their rewards to the payout destination specified for this group.

params.name: id
params.description: UUID direct reference to the existing payout group

items.docs:
Updates a payout group. Any changes to a payout group which has an on-chain component
will cause the unclaimed rewards for that group to be implicitly claimed. No details of
the implicit claiming are returned in this API response.

params.name: id
params.description: UUID direct reference to the payout group to delete

items.docs:
Deletes a payout group. A 200 response indicates the request was accepted; however,
if the payout group is registered on a blockchain, it may continue to appear for up
to a few minutes while the on-chain removal is confirmed. Once confirmed, the payout
group will no longer appear.

Deleting a payout group which has an on-chain component will cause the unclaimed
rewards for that group to be implicitly claimed. No details of the implicit claiming
are returned in this API response.
